hotspots.title: Iran's revenge threats against Western leaders
hotspots.blurb: Iran's state-backed media has published a 'revenge list' targeting 13 world leaders, including Donald Trump, Giorgia Meloni, and Benjamin Netanyahu, following the death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. The list features AI-generated images of these leaders in prison uniforms with crosshairs, signaling potential retaliation.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high-stakes geopolitical tension and the direct threats to prominent political figures, which evoke fear and urgency.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen, leader of France's Rassemblement National, has been embroiled in a legal battle over her eligibility to run in the 2027 presidential election following a conviction for misuse of EU funds. Despite the controversy, polls show her leading in potential election scenarios.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the moral and legal dilemmas surrounding Le Pen's candidacy, which polarizes public opinion and fuels debates on justice and democracy.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei's Central Bank reform push
hotspots.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei is aggressively pushing for reforms to the Central Bank's Organic Charter, aiming to curb inflation and limit state financing. This move has sparked intense debate within his party and opposition, with allies and critics clashing over its implications.
hotspots.affect: The reform push is highly charged due to its economic stakes and the internal political strife it has ignited, reflecting broader ideological battles over Argentina's future.

hotspots.title: Death of Senator Lindsey Graham
hotspots.blurb: Senator Lindsey Graham, a key ally of Donald Trump and a prominent figure in U.S. politics, died suddenly from an aortic dissection. His death has prompted widespread reactions from political leaders and raised questions about its impact on the Republican Party and Trump's agenda.
hotspots.affect: Graham's death commands attention due to his influential role in U.S. politics and the emotional outpouring from both allies and critics, highlighting the stakes of his absence in the Senate.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage's financial scandals and security concerns
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has faced intense scrutiny over undeclared gifts and financial ties to controversial donors, including a convicted fraudster. His resignation as an MP to trigger a by-election has further fueled debates over his political future and the security of UK politicians following the murder of former MP Ann Widdecombe.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the allegations of corruption and the heightened security concerns for politicians, which evoke fear and moral outrage.
